fifth great adventure. I don't particularly care about the story, I just don't want Bazira to have it."

flavourText: "There are very few devices in this world that can act as a heart for a

u050.descrText: Can be exchanged with Faustus, the Fence in The Rogue Harbour

u050.descrText: Can be exchanged with Faustus, the Fence in The Rogue Harbour
flavourText: "My schematics are clear. Once the Enigmatic Assembly is complete, it

u050.descrText: Can be exchanged with Faustus, the Fence in The Rogue Harbour

oral history. That's nonsense, of course, but it's still very old, and therefore noteworthy."
